title: Xdrip changes lock screen wallpaper
symptom: xDrip changes the lock screen wallpaper to black with current BG on the top left on a Samsung Galaxy A50.
fix: Disable the Number Wall on Lock Screen feature by going to xDrip+ Display Settings > Number Wall on Lock Screen and turning off 'Use on Lock screen'. Alternatively, keep it enabled and configure the wallpaper in 'Configure Number Wall'.
evidence_quote: You can disable this in: xDrip+ Display Settings > Number Wall on Lock Screen -> Use on Lock screen (OFF)
